name: Tsunami Restaurant & Sushi Bar (Draper / South Jordan) Salmon Nigiri, Teriyaki Bowl & Udon
brandOrRestaurant: Tsunami Restaurant & Sushi Bar (Draper & South Jordan, UT)
whyItWorks: Minutes from TownePlace Suites Draper and South Jordan: Tsunami serves top-grade sashimi/nigiri, soy-paper sushi rolls, steamed white rice bowls with grilled chicken or salmon, and soothing udon noodle soup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Salmon or Tuna Nigiri, any roll wrapped in Soy Paper (holding lemon slices, ponzu, and spicy mayo), or the Grilled Chicken/Salmon Teriyaki Bowl with white rice and miso soup.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Tsunami rolls like the "Sunshine Roll" include thin lemon slices—always order rolls without lemon or ponzu!
